entities.name: Hans von Gersdorff
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hans von Gersdorff, also known as Schyl-Hans, was a German surgeon who published the Feldbuch der Wundarzney in 1517, with instructions for procedures such as amputation. It was illustrated with woodcuts attributed to Hans Wechtlin.
